entries.finding: Stage05 item commands required explicit acceptance by the Game Core authority catalog.
entries.correction: Added USE_ITEM/EQUIP_ITEM/UNEQUIP_ITEM routes with deterministic item event references derived from the command stream.
entries.retest: Stage05 unit 22/22 PASS; Stage01 unit 12/12, validation 58/58 and stress 35/35 PASS.

entries.finding: Combined Stage05 validation+stress execution exceeded the harness limit after validation completed.
entries.correction: Validation and stress were executed as independent gates.

entries.finding: Grouped upstream regression commands exceeded the harness window even though earlier suites had completed.
entries.correction: Upstream regressions were rerun as isolated suites.

entries.finding: The Stage05 unittest suite redundantly called full global country relationship-integrity health after item integrity had already passed, causing the unit runner to exceed 240 seconds.
entries.correction: Kept item integrity in the unit scope and preserved full Stage05/global health in bootstrap, validation, stress and persistence/restore gates. Unit report runner was isolated in a subprocess. No gameplay rule was weakened.
entries.retest: Direct Stage05 unit suite 22/22 PASS; isolated unit-report runner 22/22 PASS.

entries.finding: Grouped Country V1.5 core execution timed out after six completed cases.
entries.correction: All V1.5 critical cases were executed individually.
